curvature: Full-domain quadratic projection contrast; exponentiated log contrast is a ratio of ratios. Raw contrast is identity scale mg/dL.
reference_uncertainty: Design-based 95% t confidence intervals; occupied-domain PSU minus stratum df. Full positive-weight design including zero out-of-domain score contributions.
generated_uncertainty: Point estimates only; seed variation is simulation sensitivity, structures are assumptions, neither is clinical-evidence or transport uncertainty.
calibration: Fixed CDC backward equation applied to every table; coefficient uncertainty not propagated; auxiliary only.
interpretation_limits: temporal replication within same survey program
no equivalence or absence from nonsignificance
no individual recovery or causal interpretation
